Ryzen 5 5500, RX 6500 XT (4 GB, 64-bit bus, ~144 GB/s effective is optimistic; real ~107 GB/s, 16 CUs, 16 MB Infinity Cache), 16 GB DDR4.
This GPU is memory-bandwidth and VRAM bound before it is ALU bound. Design for that:
Fewer/narrower render targets (prefer RGBA8 / R11G11B10F / RG16F over RGBA16F). Avoid >5 full-res colortex.
